name: Vial of Phlogiston
summary: At Razorfen Kraul, phlogiston draws smiths from the Alliance and Horde. Master armorers use it to temper mail for promising warriors, while quilboar guard it in their stronghold.

sections.title: Essence of the Forge
sections.body: Phlogiston bears volatile fire and has a place in esoteric metalwork. Furen Longbeard, a dwarven smith in Stormwind, needs it, as does Thun'grim Firegaze, a near-blind orc armorer in the Barrens. Both use it to harden warrior armor beyond ordinary physical limits. Without this alchemical agent, neither can complete the specialized forging of Fire Hardened Mail or the Horde's Brutal Armor.

sections.title: Retrieved from the Brambles
sections.body: A vial of phlogiston lies deep in Razorfen Kraul, amid the tangled thickets at the southern tip of the Barrens. The geomancer Roogug holds it in the bristling redoubt. Whether it is bound for Furen in Stormwind or for Thun'grim's anvil across the dust, reaching it means a perilous descent into hostile quilboar territory.

faq.answer: Master smiths use phlogiston as an alchemical tempering catalyst. Its concentrated heat hardens raw mail and iron into exceptionally durable warrior armor.

faq.q: Who carries the Vial of Phlogiston?
aliases: where to get vial of phlogiston
faq.answer: Roogug, a quilboar geomancer, carries the vial deep within the thorned tunnels of Razorfen Kraul in the southern Barrens.
Furen Longbeard in Stormwind and Thun'grim Firegaze in the Barrens both need phlogiston to forge unique, hardened armor suits for seasoned warriors.

angles.text: As a warrior, retrieving phlogiston is an essential step toward earning iconic tempered armor. It proves you can breach Razorfen Kraul.
As a blacksmith, you know phlogiston as a vital flux for specialized metallurgy, used to temper legendary mail plate.
